resolution.note: fix(slice): wait for the pushed PR head before review (t-vxshve4)

title: slice run waits for the PR head before review after a push
body:
Outcome: after the pr stage pushes a new head, the review stage waits (bounded) until `gh pr view` reports that headRefOid before calling `krn review`, instead of failing 64 "authoritative PR number/base/head does not match requested review".
Evidence: PR #206 second round (.krn/runs/lead/review-override/slice-review2b.log): push succeeded, review exited 64 immediately; a rerun minutes later passed admission. Related transient: deliver exit 76 "check runs unavailable" while krn/gate was already success (deliver.log), resumed with exit 0.
Proof: an observer where the stub PR head lags one poll behind the push; review is called once with the new head.

Lead trap: when slice review exits 64 'authoritative PR number/base/head does not match' right after a push, check `gh pr view <n> --json headRefOid` equals the local HEAD, then rerun the same slice command; a deliver exit 76 'check runs unavailable' with krn/gate already success is resumed by rerunning deliver.
